findings.title: OAuth2 user-actor flow for each customer
findings.detail: Create an OAuth2 application with redirect callback URLs, redirect users to linear.app/oauth/authorize with a state value (PKCE is supported), then exchange the code at api.linear.app/oauth/token. actor=user is the default and acts as the authorizing user. Access tokens last 24 hours and are refreshed with a refresh token.

steps.title: Read first page of issue titles
steps.detail: POST a GraphQL query with the access token to read issue titles. Expected output: up to 50 issues in data.issues.nodes, each with id and title, plus pageInfo. Boundary check: inspect the granted scope in the token response (should be only read) and confirm the outgoing request log contains only this query; do not run any mutation. First request of the full listing, using first and requesting pageInfo. Pagination is Relay cursor style. Expected output: nodes[] with id and title, pageInfo.hasNextPage and pageInfo.endCursor. Boundary check: query only; no mutations in the outgoing log.
steps.doneWhen: Response has data.issues.nodes[] with title values, and pageInfo.hasNextPage and pageInfo.endCursor. Page returned with nodes[].title and pageInfo.endCursor recorded.

evidence.quote: --data '{ "query": "{ issues { nodes { id title } } }" }' \
